name: Death Dog
description: A dark canine monster with exactly two separate dog heads on one four-legged body.

Subject: A dark canine monster with exactly two separate dog heads on one four-legged body. Genuine transparent background. One complete centered subject with a one-pixel clear margin. Full body for creatures, full object for equipment. No scenery or extra objects beyond the stated subject.
